lines.en: label chikadate45:
I tap on Chika’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点下 Chika 的名字，等她接听。

lines.en: And, since it’s still early in the day, I figure that meeting up with her now will give her the chance to {i}not{/i} have to monitor her instinct to always act like we’re the world’s cutest couple.
lines.zh: 而且，现在还早，我想这会儿见她，能让她有机会{i}不用{/i}时刻压抑自己「我俩是天下最甜情侣」的本能。

lines.en: She’s been having to do a lot of that lately. And...let’s just say that I’ve been a little closer to feeling bad than I normally am after telling her to tone it down.
lines.zh: 最近她老得这么憋着。而且……这么说吧，上次我叫她收敛点之后，我比平常更有点于心不忍。

lines.en: A break can be good for everyone.
lines.zh: 缓一缓对谁都好。

lines.en: Depending on the {i}type{/i} of break, of course. Because I’m pretty sure if I asked Chika to take a {i}real{/i} break, all hell would break loose.
lines.zh: 当然，得看是{i}哪种{/i}「缓」。因为我很确定，我要是让 Chika {i}真的{/i}「分手冷静一下」，天就要塌了。

lines.en: But that’s enough iterations of the word “break” for the moment.
lines.zh: 不过「break」这个词先说到这。

lines.en: Here’s hoping she’s awake, I guess.
lines.zh: 希望她已经醒了吧。

lines.en: : Hey! Good morning!
lines.zh: : 嘿！早上好！

lines.en: : Hey. You sure seem lively for someone who probably just woke up.
lines.zh: : 嘿。你这刚醒的人，精神头可真足。

lines.en: : Chinami wanted waffles, so I had to run over to the store to get stuff for them.
lines.zh: : Chinami 想吃华夫饼，所以我得跑去商店买材料。

lines.en: : Stop letting her control your life. If you don’t want to make waffles, don’t make waffles. It’s as simple as that.
lines.zh: : 别再让她支配你的人生。不想做华夫饼就别做，就这么简单。

lines.en: : Do you...have something against waffles, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你……是看不惯华夫饼吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : I have something against eternal kindness. And waffles just appear to be the connection between that and you this morning.
lines.zh: : 我是看不惯那种没底线的善良。而华夫饼今早刚好成了你跟它之间的纽带。

lines.en: : Do you want me to be meaner to Chinami or something?
lines.zh: : 你是想让我对 Chinami 凶一点什么的？

lines.en: : {i}Who wants to be mean to Chinami?! She wants to give them a piece of her mind!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}谁想对 Chinami 凶啊？！她还想好好数落你一顿呢！{/i}

lines.en: : Shush. Eat your waffles.
lines.zh: : 嘘。吃你的华夫饼。

lines.en: : {i}Okay! I love you, big sister!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}好！我爱你，姐姐！{/i}

lines.en: : Do you hear that? {i}That’s{/i} who you want me to be mean to.
lines.zh: : 听见没？{i}这{/i}就是你想让我凶的对象。

lines.en: : I never said-
lines.zh: : 我可没说——

lines.en: : You know what, forget it. Are you busy this morning?
lines.zh: : 行了，当我没说。你今早忙吗？

lines.en: : Nope!
lines.zh: : 不忙！

lines.en: : Sweet.
lines.zh: : 太好了。

lines.en: : Mhm. I guess it is pretty sweet.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。我想确实挺好的。

lines.en: : This is the part where you’re supposed to invite me over.
lines.zh: : 这时候你应该开口邀请我过去才对。

lines.en: : Is it? I wasn’t sure if that would be moving too quickly.
lines.zh: : 是吗？我不确定那样会不会进展太快了。

lines.en: : Sensei! It was a joke! Of course you can come over.
lines.zh: : Sensei！我开玩笑的！你当然可以过来。

lines.en: : I’m not making you waffles unless you bring more ingredients, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你不带材料来，我可不做华夫饼给你。

lines.en: : I think I’m okay without waffles. I’ll see you soon.
lines.zh: : 我不吃华夫饼也行。一会儿见。

lines.en: : We’ll be here!
lines.zh: : 我们在这儿等你！

lines.en: scene black
I hang up the phone and start getting ready to head to Chika’s place.
lines.zh: 我挂了电话，开始收拾，准备往 Chika 家去。

lines.en: When I make it to the second half of town, I see a surprising amount of its inhabitants showing a bit more life than they normally do at this time of day.
lines.zh: 走到城的另一半，我意外发现这儿的居民比平常这个时候多了几分生气。

lines.en: Upon trying to come up with a reason for their sudden shift in behavior, I decide to go with the simple fact that the seasons are changing.
lines.zh: 想找个他们行为突变的原因，我就归结为最简单的那个——季节在变。

lines.en: And that, soon enough, they’ll be wandering around in search of shade or shadows instead of fire.
lines.zh: 而且用不了多久，他们找的就是阴凉和影子，而不是火了。

lines.en: Good luck, old district. I wish you the best in your endless battle against death and nature.
lines.zh: 祝你好运，老城区。祝你在这场对抗死亡与自然的无休止战斗里好运。

lines.en: scene controversialscene1
I step into the Chosokabe apartment to find absolutely no one.
lines.zh: 我走进长宗我部家的公寓，一个人影都没有。

lines.en: Could it be that Chika was so torn up about me asking her to slow down that she took her sister and moved to some far away land?
lines.zh: 难道 Chika 因为我叫她收敛点，伤心到带着妹妹搬到什么遥远的国度去了？

lines.en: And, if that’s the case, why did she invite me here? Is this all just to inconvenience me?
lines.zh: 要真是那样，她干嘛还叫我来？就是为了折腾我？

lines.en: That bitch.
lines.zh: 这贱人。

lines.en: : In here, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 在里面呢，Sensei！

lines.en: : The bathroom?...
: Don’t worry! It’s safe to come in.
lines.zh: : 别担心！进来没事的。

lines.en: jump chinamibrx
label restofchinamibr:
scene controversialscene14
Chinami jumps onto the bed next to me, wearing nothing but an oversized t-shirt, before gazing into my eyes with a look that essentially screams, “I am secretly evil.”
lines.zh: Chinami 跳到我旁边的床上，只套了件超大的 T 恤，然后直勾勾盯着我的眼睛，那眼神等于在喊「我其实是个坏孩子」。

lines.en: : Chinami, come on. That’s my spot.
lines.zh: : Chinami，起来。那是我的位置。

lines.en: : Chinami wants to know what your intentions are with her big sister.
lines.zh: : Chinami 想知道你对我姐姐是什么企图。

lines.en: : Chinami should mind her own fucking business.
lines.zh: : Chinami 该管好自己的破事。

lines.en: scene controversialscene15
: Did you just curse at Chinami?! You can’t do that!
lines.zh: : 你刚才居然骂 Chinami 脏话？！你不能那样！

lines.en: : Go put all of your money in the swear jar!
lines.zh: : 快把你所有的钱都投进脏话罐里！

lines.en: : Do you actually have one of those things?
lines.zh: : 你们还真有那玩意儿？

lines.en: : Why else do you think Yumi is so poor?
lines.zh: : 不然你以为 Yumi 为什么那么穷？

lines.en: scene controversialscene16
: Oh crap. I can’t believe I just made that joke. I’m sorry, Yumi. If it makes you feel any better, I’m also poor.
lines.zh: : 哦糟。我不敢相信自己真说了那玩笑。对不起，Yumi。要是能让你好受点——我也很穷。

lines.en: : While big sis Chika apologizes to the air, Chinami demands that you be nicer to her in the future.
lines.zh: : 趁 Chika 姐姐对着空气道歉，Chinami 要求你以后对她好点。

lines.en: : To you? Or to your sister?
lines.zh: : 对你？还是对你姐姐？

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 都是。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Well, uhh...okay.
lines.zh: : 呃，好吧……行。

lines.en: : Good.
lines.zh: : 很好。

lines.en: : Chinami will give back her sister’s spot now, but she’ll be watching you...
lines.zh: : Chinami 现在把姐姐的位置还给你，但她会盯着你的……

lines.en: : Sure, Chinami. And I’ll make sure to drop a coin in your swear jar the next time I have cash on me.
lines.zh: : 行啊，Chinami。我下次身上带现金，就给你投一枚进脏话罐。

lines.en: scene black
Chinami gets off the bed and, within a matter of seconds, Chika stops apologizing to the spirit of Yumi for calling her poor and lays down beside me.
lines.zh: Chinami 下了床。没几秒，Chika 不再为「说她穷」向 Yumi 的在天之灵道歉，躺到了我身边。

lines.en: She rests her head on my lap and talks a little about how she really doesn’t want to go into work later because of the holiday rush, and I sit there the same way I always do and pretend to be interested.
lines.zh: 她把头搁在我腿上，念叨着她其实多不想等会儿去上班，因为节日大促人多——我就跟平常一样坐在那儿装出感兴趣的样子。

lines.en: Before long, though, the conversation begins to die down and more gaps begin to form- ones even larger than the half-open bathroom door that she and her sister emerged from just a short while ago.
lines.zh: 不过没多久，对话渐渐冷场，空隙越来越大——比她俩刚才钻出来的那扇半开的浴室门缝还大。

lines.en: But I guess there have been plenty of gaps forming between us as of late.
lines.zh: 但我想，最近我们之间本来就生出了不少缝隙。

lines.en: Gaps between what we want to do and what we have to do.
lines.zh: 想做的和不得不做的之间的缝隙。

lines.en: Gaps between what we {i}actually{/i} do and what we struggle to.
lines.zh: {i}实际{/i}做的和拼了命想做的之间的缝隙。

lines.en: Gaps in our own personal mindsets as they sink further into a pit that will be near impossible to climb out of if neither one of us has climbing equipment.
lines.zh: 还有我们各自心态上的缝隙——它们越陷越深，要是我们俩谁都没带攀爬装备，几乎不可能爬得出来。

lines.en: Chika didn’t bring hers as she believed me to be some sort of experienced climber.
lines.zh: Chika 没带她的装备，因为她把我当成了经验丰富的攀岩老手。

lines.en: And I am.
lines.zh: 而我确实是。

lines.en: But the truth is that I don’t even know how to use my equipment.
lines.zh: 可真相是，我连自己的装备都不会用。

lines.en: And, at this point, I don’t know if it’s even worth the effort to learn.
lines.zh: 而且到了这个地步，我都不知道值不值得花力气去学了。

lines.en: scene controversialscene17
The biggest gap of all is one of consciousness as Chika passes out on my lap.
lines.zh: 最大的缝隙是意识上的——Chika 在我腿上睡死了过去。

lines.en: I don’t mean to, but somewhere along the line, I rest my hand on her head and begin stroking her hair.
lines.zh: 我不是故意的，但不知不觉间，我把手搭在她头上，开始抚她的头发。

lines.en: It’s slightly damp, so I’m able to figure out that she took a bath before Chinami.
lines.zh: 头发有点湿，所以我知道她比 Chinami 先洗了澡。

lines.en: But, with that {i}and{/i} a trip to the store...just how early did she have to wake up?
lines.zh: 可洗了澡，{i}又{/i}跑了一趟商店……她到底多早就起了？

lines.en: scene controversialscene18
: Yes, Chinami?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Chinami？

lines.en: : Nothing.
lines.zh: : 没什么。

lines.en: : Chinami is just happy you’re here.
lines.zh: : Chinami 只是很高兴你来了。

lines.en: scene controversialscene19
: Big sis hasn’t been sleeping much lately. But she was able to fall asleep on you right away.
lines.zh: : 姐姐最近都没怎么睡。但她一沾着你就睡着了。

lines.en: : She must really, really like you.
lines.zh: : 她一定特别、特别喜欢你。

lines.en: : Yeah. She must.
lines.zh: : 是啊。一定是。

lines.en: scene controversialscene20
: Can Chinami tell you a secret?
lines.zh: : Chinami 能告诉你一个秘密吗？

lines.en: : Chinami is probably going to tell me anyway, so yeah.
lines.zh: : 反正你多半也会说，那就说吧。

lines.en: : Well, last night, Chinami woke up in the middle of the night because she was thirsty, but she never got out of bed.
lines.zh: : 是这样的，昨晚 Chinami 半夜渴醒了，但她一直没下床。

lines.en: : What a fascinating secret. Thank you, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 真是个精彩的秘密。谢谢你，Chinami。

lines.en: : No, no. You don’t understand.
lines.zh: : 不对不对。你不懂。

lines.en: : Chinami didn’t {i}want{/i} to get out of bed because her sister was crying.
lines.zh: : Chinami 不{i}想{/i}下床，是因为姐姐在哭。

lines.en: scene controversialscene21
: So she just pretended to stay asleep and hugged her instead.
lines.zh: : 所以她就假装还睡着，抱住了姐姐。

lines.en: : Did you two get into a fight?
lines.zh: : 你们俩吵架了？

lines.en: : Something like that.
lines.zh: : 差不多吧。

lines.en: : Does this mean you’re going to stop coming over?
lines.zh: : 那是不是说明，你以后不来了？

lines.en: : No, it doesn’t.
lines.zh: : 不是。

lines.en: Not...now, at least.
lines.zh: 至少……现在不是。

lines.en: I have no idea what’s going to happen in the future-
lines.zh: 我不知道将来会发生什么——

lines.en: Or what other gaps will form.
lines.zh: 也不知道还会生出什么样的缝隙。

lines.en: : That’s good.
lines.zh: : 那就好。

lines.en: scene controversialscene22
: Chinami likes when you’re here. And she doesn’t want to hear her sister cry anymore.
lines.zh: : Chinami 喜欢你在这儿。而且她不想再听见姐姐哭了。

lines.en: : Do you have to hear that often?
lines.zh: : 你经常得听她哭吗？

lines.en: : Not really.
lines.zh: : 不常。

lines.en: : Not since Mommy died.
lines.zh: : 妈妈去世之后就很少了。

lines.en: : But Chinami thinks big sis Chika will stop crying as much if you tell her you love her.
lines.zh: : 但 Chinami 觉得，只要你跟姐姐说你爱她，她就不会哭那么多了。

lines.en: : Or give Chinami a little sister.
lines.zh: : 或者给 Chinami 生个小妹妹。

lines.en: : Okay, stop that.
lines.zh: : 行了，打住。

lines.en: : Chinami will convince you one day.
lines.zh: : Chinami 总有一天会说服你的。

lines.en: : If Chika had a baby, it wouldn’t even be your sister. It would be your [niece].
lines.zh: : Chika 要是生了孩子，那也不是你妹妹，是你[侄女/外甥女]。

lines.en: scene controversialscene23
: Chinami would be an aunt?!
lines.zh: : Chinami 要当阿姨了？！

lines.en: : Yes. And you’re way too young to be an aunt.
lines.zh: : 对。可你当阿姨也太小了。

lines.en: : This is a really sticky situation!
lines.zh: : 这真是个大麻烦！

lines.en: : That’s right. So, for everyone’s sake, please stop asking me to have a baby with your sister.
lines.zh: : 就是。所以为了大家好，别再叫我跟你姐姐生孩子了。

lines.en: scene controversialscene24
: Fine! But Chinami isn’t happy about it!
lines.zh: : 好吧！但 Chinami 不高兴！

lines.en: : Chinami seems to very rarely be happy about anything I do.
lines.zh: : 我做什么 Chinami 好像都很少高兴。

lines.en: scene controversialscene25
: Then make it up to her by not letting big sis cry anymore.
lines.zh: : 那就用「不再让姐姐哭」来补偿她。

lines.en: : Chinami can only do so much to cheer her up all alone. She needs your help.
lines.zh: : Chinami 一个人再怎么逗姐姐开心也有限。她需要你帮忙。

lines.en: : I’ll see what I can do...
lines.zh: : 我尽量吧……

lines.en: scene black
Chinami lays down beside her sister and falls asleep as well.
lines.zh: Chinami 在姐姐身边躺下，也睡着了。

lines.en: Next thing I know, I’m surrounded by two lightly breathing, unconscious blondes and unable to figure out a way to escape this situation.
lines.zh: 等我回过神，身边围着两个呼吸轻轻、没了知觉的金发姑娘，而我找不到脱身的办法。

lines.en: Not that it’s a bad one, just...not how I imagined my morning going.
lines.zh: 倒也不是说这处境不好，只是……跟我预想的早晨不太一样。

lines.en: But, I guess there are more ways to ensure that these two get a good night’s sleep than just buying them a brand new bed.
lines.zh: 不过我想，想让这俩睡个好觉，办法也不止给她们买张新床这一条。

lines.en: Or...good morning’s sleep.
lines.zh: 或者说……睡个好「早」觉。

lines.en: I’ll just hang around here until they wake up, I guess.
lines.zh: 那我就待在这儿，等她们醒来吧。

lines.en: $ chika_love += 1
$ chinami_love += 1
$ chikadate45 = True
{i}Chika’s affection has increased to [chika_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Chika 的好感度提升到了 [chika_love]!{/i}

lines.en: {i}Chinami’s affection has increased to [chinami_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Chinami 的好感度提升到了 [chinami_love]!{/i}

lines.en: {i}Both sisters wake up a few hours later and you’re able to get on with the rest of your day...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}几小时后，姐妹俩都醒了，你也得以继续这一天剩下的时光……{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdayafternoon
label chinamibrx:
: I would...sure hope so.
lines.zh: : 我……当然希望如此。

lines.en: scene controversialscene2
: Papa!
lines.zh: : 爸爸！

lines.en: scene controversialscene1
: Nope.
lines.zh: : 不了。

lines.en: : What? What’s wrong?
lines.zh: : 什么？怎么了？

lines.en: : What do you mean what’s wrong? You said it was safe to come in.
lines.zh: : 什么叫怎么了？你不是说进来没事吗。

lines.en: : Hm? Cause of Chinami? She’s just a kid, it’s no big deal.
lines.zh: : 嗯？因为 Chinami？她还是个孩子，没什么大不了的。

lines.en: : It’s not like I’m giving Yumi a bath in here.
lines.zh: : 我又不是在这儿给 Yumi 洗澡。

lines.en: : That’s exactly {i}why{/i} it’s a problem. I would have stayed inside without a question if Yumi was in there.
lines.zh: : 这{i}正是{/i}问题所在。要是 Yumi 在里面，我肯定毫不犹豫地待着。

lines.en: : Hey. Watch it.
lines.zh: : 喂。你说话注意点。

lines.en: : Why won’t Papa come inside? Is he afraid of the bath?
lines.zh: : 爸爸为什么不进来？他是怕浴缸吗？

lines.en: : I guess he just hates you, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 我猜他就是讨厌你，Chinami。

lines.en: : I don’t-
lines.zh: : 我不是——

lines.en: : Papa, why?!
lines.zh: : 爸爸，为什么？！

lines.en: Am I really the weird one for thinking the right thing to do is wait out here?
lines.zh: 我觉得在外面等着才是对的，难道我真是那个怪人？

lines.en: I get that Chika’s comfortable enough with me that she doesn’t feel threatened about me being around...that.
lines.zh: 我知道 Chika 跟我够亲近，不介意我在……那个……旁边。

lines.en: But why would I even go in there if I can just talk to them through the gap in the door?
lines.zh: 可我既然能隔着门缝跟她们说话，干嘛非进去不可？

lines.en: : Stop being so sketchy and come in already. I’ve just gotta get the soap out of her hair.
lines.zh: : 别鬼鬼祟祟的，快进来。我只需要把她头发里的泡沫冲掉。

lines.en: : Chinami misses you! And you should want to spend time with her because no one knows how much time she has left!
lines.zh: : Chinami 想你！而且你应该多陪陪她，因为谁也不知道她还能活多久！

lines.en: : Chinami! Stop saying that! I mean it!
lines.zh: : Chinami！别再说那个了！我说真的！

lines.en: : Yes, big Sister...
lines.zh: : 好的，姐姐……

lines.en: : Do it again and I’m taking your phone away. That’s not funny.
lines.zh: : 再说一次我就没收你手机。那一点都不好笑。

lines.en: What...should I do here?
lines.zh: 我……该怎么办？

lines.en: menu:
lines.zh: menu:

lines.en: Wait outside
lines.zh: 在外面等

lines.en: : If you’re almost done, I’ll just wait out here.
lines.zh: : 你们要是快洗完了，我就在外面等。

lines.en: : There’s really no need for me to be in there right now anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正我现在也没必要非在里面。

lines.en: : Not sure why you’re being so weird about this, but okay. Do whatever makes you comfortable, I guess.
lines.zh: : 搞不懂你干嘛这么别扭，不过行吧。你觉得怎么舒服就怎么来。

lines.en: scene black
I avert my gaze as I make my way into the combined living room and bedroom, collapsing onto the same worn down mattress these sisters so often fall asleep on together.
lines.zh: 我移开视线，走进那间客厅兼卧室，瘫倒在这对姐妹常一起睡的那张破旧床垫上。

lines.en: And as I wait for the two of them to finish in the bathroom, I’m stricken by the unhealthy thought that I now want to buy them a new bed in addition to their phones.
lines.zh: 一边等她们俩洗完澡，我一边冒出一个不健康的念头：除了手机，我现在还想给她们买张新床。

lines.en: Maybe this is just one more way I can trick myself into thinking I’m somehow a positive influence on their lives...but maybe it’s more than that?
lines.zh: 也许这只是我骗自己「我对她们的人生多少是个正面影响」的又一种方式……但也许不止如此？

lines.en: Maybe I {i}do{/i} actually want to help them? Or...give them better lives or something.
lines.zh: 也许我{i}是{/i}真想帮她们？或者……让她们过上好日子之类的。

lines.en: Or maybe that’s just me imagining a single trace of light in a world I believe to be devoid of it.
lines.zh: 又或者，那只是我在一个我认为毫无光亮的世界里，凭空想象出的一丝光。

lines.en: You can’t give someone a better life by just handing them things they’d have trouble obtaining on their own.
lines.zh: 你不能光靠把别人自己难得的东西塞给他们，就让人过上好日子。

lines.en: Sure, it would make things a little better for them in the moment, but what comes after that?
lines.zh: 是，那样眼下是能让他们好过点，可那之后呢？

lines.en: Chika’s already starting to depend on me a little too much.
lines.zh: Chika 已经开始有点太依赖我了。

lines.en: But I guess it would be hard {i}not{/i} to depend on me when I’m the first person in a long time that’s actually felt depend{i}able{/i}.
lines.zh: 不过也难怪——我是这么久以来第一个让她觉得{i}靠得住{/i}的人。

lines.en: It’s sad.
lines.zh: 挺可悲的。

lines.en: I thought she was smarter than this.
lines.zh: 我原以为她比这聪明。

Go in. This is normal.
lines.zh: 进去吧。这很正常。

lines.en: Chika’s right.
lines.zh: Chika 说得对。

lines.en: This would only be a big deal if I turned it into one.
lines.zh: 这事只有我把它当回事，才算回事。

lines.en: And treating Chinami like she’s a normal girl instead of what she really is would be the number one way to do that.
lines.zh: 而把 Chinami 当成普通女孩、而不是她「真正的身份」来对待，正是把它当回事的头号做法。

lines.en: In fact, Chika would probably be more suspicious {i}if{/i} I stayed outside.
lines.zh: 其实，我{i}要是{/i}待在外面，Chika 反而会更起疑。

lines.en: That’s right.
lines.zh: 没错。

lines.en: This is normal.
lines.zh: 这很正常。

lines.en: {i}I{/i} am normal.
lines.zh: {i}我{/i}很正常。

lines.en: scene controversialscene3
$ sawchinami = True
: Hooray! Papa doesn’t hate Chinami after all!
lines.zh: : 万岁！爸爸原来不讨厌 Chinami！

lines.en: : You good?
lines.zh: : 你还好吧？

lines.en: : Yeah. I just thought Chinami would feel uncomfortable having a boy in here. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我只是觉得 Chinami 会不习惯屋里有个男生。仅此而已。

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t know why that would change anything. She likes Papa and wants him to {i}always{/i} be around.
lines.zh: : Chinami 不懂那有什么关系。她喜欢爸爸，想让他{i}一直{/i}在身边。

lines.en: : And {i}Chika{/i} didn’t realize this was going to be a point of contention.
lines.zh: : 而且 {i}Chika{/i} 也没想到这居然会成个问题。

lines.en: : Well, {i}Sensei{/i} thinks it’s time to talk about something else before this gets even weirder.
lines.zh: : 行吧，{i}Sensei{/i} 觉得在事情变得更怪之前，该聊点别的了。

lines.en: : Chinami is pleased with how everyone is speaking now. She feels like she is starting a trend.
lines.zh: : Chinami 对大家现在的说话方式很满意。她觉得自己带动了一股潮流。

lines.en: scene controversialscene4
: {i}Chinami{/i} should learn to wash her own hair instead of making her big sister do it all the time.
lines.zh: : {i}Chinami{/i} 该学着自己洗头，别老让姐姐洗。

lines.en: : And she should also take off her ribbon when she’s in the bath.
lines.zh: : 而且洗澡的时候也该把发带摘了。

lines.en: : But if Chinami takes off her ribbon, Chinami will deflate! It is what keeps all of the air inside of her! And where she stores her magic!
lines.zh: : 可 Chinami 要是摘了发带，Chinami 会漏气的！那是把气全锁在里面的东西！也是她存魔法的地方！

lines.en: Just like I thought.
lines.zh: 果然跟我想的一样。

lines.en: This is all completely normal.
lines.zh: 这一切完全正常。

lines.en: scene controversialscene5
: Papa, help! Chinami wants you to wash her hair instead! Big sis Chika is being too rough!
lines.zh: : 爸爸，救命！Chinami 想让你帮她洗头！Chika 姐姐洗得太用力了！

lines.en: : I’m good right here, thanks.
lines.zh: : 我在这儿挺好，谢了。

lines.en: scene controversialscene6
: Want me to wash {i}your{/i} hair next, Sensei? Tub’s already full. Might as well get as much out of the water as we can.
lines.zh: : 要不要我接着帮{i}你{/i}洗，Sensei？浴缸水都放满了，不如多利用利用。

lines.en: : Again, I’m good right here. I think that tub might be a little too small for me anyway.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，我在这儿挺好。反正那浴缸对我可能也太小了点。

lines.en: scene controversialscene7
: Suit yourself! Don’t come crying to me when you run up your water bill, though.
lines.zh: : 随你！不过等你水费账单爆了，可别来哭着找我。

lines.en: : The water bill is a mostly negligible cost once you aren’t confined to working a minimum wage retail job anymore.
lines.zh: : 一旦你不再被最低工资的零售工作绑死，水费基本可以忽略不计。

lines.en: : Oh yeah? Wanna help {i}me{/i} go look for a new one, then? You know, since you’re already helping Yumi and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 哦是吗？那要不要帮{i}我{/i}找份新的？反正你已经在帮 Yumi 了嘛。

lines.en: : Big sis Yumi will never get a job. She’s too misunderstood.
lines.zh: : Yumi 姐姐永远找不到工作的。她太不被人理解了。

lines.en: : You’d certainly be easier to find one for.
lines.zh: : 你可比她好找工作多了。

lines.en: : I think you should be fine where you are until you’re out of school, though. If you can’t find a new job after that, {i}then{/i} I’ll help you go hunting.
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得你毕业前先干着现在这个就行。之后要是找不到新的，我{i}再{/i}帮你一起找。

lines.en: : Yumi’s just getting {i}all{/i} the special treatment then, huh? Job hunting {i}and{/i} bath company.
lines.zh: : 那 Yumi 就是{i}独享{/i}特殊待遇喽？帮找工作，{i}还{/i}陪洗澡。

lines.en: : Hey, I never would have offered to watch her if you didn’t bring the idea up.
lines.zh: : 喂，要不是你先提出来，我才不会说要看着她。

lines.en: : Well, I’ll be sure to relay it to her the next time she goes to wash her hair.
lines.zh: : 行，下次她去洗头，我一定替你转达。

lines.en: : Please don’t. She hates me enough as is. The last thing I need is her knowing that I’m getting myself involved in conversations like this.
lines.zh: : 千万别。她已经够讨厌我了。我可不想再让她知道我掺和进这种对话。

lines.en: scene controversialscene8
: Chinami thinks big sis Yumi likes you a lot and that she just doesn’t know how to express it!
lines.zh: : Chinami 觉得 Yumi 姐姐其实很喜欢你，只是她不知道怎么表达！

lines.en: : She always says she never had a mom or a dad, so Chinami thinks that she never learned how to be nice.
lines.zh: : 她老说自己没有爸爸妈妈，所以 Chinami 觉得她从没学过怎么待人友善。

lines.en: : If somebody teaches big sis Yumi to be nice, Chinami thinks she’ll start saying less mean things to you.
lines.zh: : 要是有人教 Yumi 姐姐友善一点，Chinami 觉得她就不会老对你说难听的话了。

lines.en: : Why don’t {i}you{/i} teach her to be nice, Chinami?
lines.zh: : 那{i}你{/i}干嘛不教她友善点，Chinami？

lines.en: scene controversialscene9
: Chinami tries! But big sis Yumi has already tried to kill her once!
lines.zh: : Chinami 有试啊！可 Yumi 姐姐已经想杀过她一次了！

lines.en: : Is this about the peanuts?
lines.zh: : 是为了花生那事？

lines.en: : It’s about the peanuts.
lines.zh: : 就是为了花生。

lines.en: : Nowhere is safe for Chinami! This is a dog eat dog world, and Chinami {i}is{/i} a dog sometimes!
lines.zh: : Chinami 到哪儿都不安全！这是个狗咬狗的世界，而 Chinami {i}有{/i}时候也是条狗！

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. How about we just {i}both{/i} try to teach Yumi how to be nice, then?
lines.zh: : 行行行。那要不{i}咱俩{/i}一起教 Yumi 怎么友善点？

lines.en: scene controversialscene10
: Just not {i}too{/i} nice. Because then {i}Papa{/i} might think twice about coming over here to see {i}me{/i}.
lines.zh: : 就是别{i}太{/i}友善。不然{i}爸爸{/i}可能会重新考虑要不要来看{i}我{/i}。

lines.en: : Hey, I’m here for Chinami. You’re just a bonus.
lines.zh: : 喂，我是来看 Chinami 的。你只是附带的。

lines.en: scene controversialscene11
: Uh-huh. Right. So you just dialed my number by mistake this morning?
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。是吗。那你今早是「不小心」拨错我的号？

lines.en: : Your numbers are right next to each other in my phone. I probably just tapped the wrong one.
lines.zh: : 你俩的号码在我手机里挨着。我大概就是点错了。

lines.en: : Be careful, big sister! It looks like you might really have to worry after all!
lines.zh: : 小心点，姐姐！看来你说不定真得担心一下了！

lines.en: scene controversialscene12
: Hey! Shh! I told you not to talk about that! I wasn’t “worrying” about anything! I was just...thinking!
lines.zh: : 喂！嘘！我不是叫你别提那个吗！我才没「担心」什么！我只是……在想！

lines.en: : Chinami can’t be stopped! And she can’t help if Papa likes her more than her big sister!
lines.zh: : Chinami 停不下来！而且要是爸爸喜欢她胜过姐姐，那也不是她的错！

lines.en: : Worrying?
lines.zh: : 担心？

lines.en: : About what we talked about at the mall?
lines.zh: : 担心我们在商场聊的那件事？

lines.en: scene controversialscene13
: Um...could you give the two of us a minute, Sensei? I’d like to remind my sister about certain things I don’t want her saying around you.
lines.zh: : 那个……你能给我俩一分钟吗，Sensei？我想提醒我妹妹，有些话我不想让她当你面说。

lines.en: : Please?
lines.zh: : 拜托了？

lines.en: : Sure. Though, it is a little weird to be kicked out of this room when you practically begged me to come inside.
lines.zh: : 行。不过你刚才几乎是求我进来，现在又把我赶出这屋，是有点怪。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t say I {i}begged{/i}...
lines.zh: : 我才没有{i}求{/i}你……

lines.en: scene black
: I would.
lines.zh: : 我会这么说。

lines.en: Especially since it helps me justify how long I just hung around my fake girlfriend’s naked sister for.
lines.zh: 尤其因为这能帮我合理化：我刚才在我「假女友」的裸体妹妹身边耗了那么久。

lines.en: As I leave the room, though, I realize that I {i}was{/i} just making a big deal over nothing-
lines.zh: 不过走出房间时，我意识到自己刚才{i}是{/i}小题大做了——

lines.en: And that just seeing someone without their clothes on isn’t enough for me to {i}want{/i} them.
lines.zh: 而且，光是看到一个人没穿衣服，并不足以让我{i}想{/i}要她。

lines.en: I’m not used to that.
lines.zh: 我不习惯这样。

lines.en: I’m not used to feeling like I’m in complete control over how I feel because, frankly, most of the time, I’m not.
lines.zh: 我不习惯觉得自己能完全掌控自己的感受，因为坦白说，大多数时候我做不到。

lines.en: I’m glad that today I was, though.
lines.zh: 不过我很高兴，今天我做到了。

lines.en: And I hope that, at least for a while longer-
lines.zh: 而且我希望，至少再过一阵子——

lines.en: I will continue to be.
lines.zh: 我能一直做到。

lines.en: I make my way into the combined living room and bedroom, collapsing onto the same worn down mattress the Chosokabe sisters so often fall asleep on together.
lines.zh: 我走进那间客厅兼卧室，瘫倒在长宗我部姐妹常一起睡的那张破旧床垫上。

lines.en: And as I wait for the two of them to finish in the bathroom, I’m stricken by the unhealthy thought that I now want to buy them a new bed in addition to their phones.

lines.zh: 也许这只是我骗自己「我对她们的人生多少是个正面影响」的又一种方式……但也许不止如此？

lines.en: Maybe I {i}do{/i} actually want to help them? Or...give them better lives or something.
lines.zh: 也许我{i}是{/i}真想帮她们？或者……让她们过上好日子之类的。

lines.zh: 又或者，那只是我在一个我认为毫无光亮的世界里，凭空想象出的一丝光。

lines.en: Sure, it would make things a little better for them in the moment, but what comes after that?
lines.zh: 是，那样眼下是能让他们好过点，可那之后呢？

lines.en: Chika’s already starting to depend on me a little too much.
lines.zh: Chika 已经开始有点太依赖我了。

lines.en: But I guess it would be hard {i}not{/i} to be when I’m the first person in a long time that’s actually felt depend{i}able{/i}.
lines.zh: 不过也难怪——我是这么久以来第一个让她觉得{i}靠得住{/i}的人。

lines.en: It’s sad.

lines.zh: 我一直以为她比这聪明。
